name: 3S Pathfinder (Rust)
author: Joakim
description: BFS path search for the chaos-sea bots, compiled to WebAssembly. Loads next to them and answers their map.path.find events; each falls back to its own Lua search when this isn't loaded. (The retired dead-reckoning 3s-map used it too; the GMCP mapper has its own search.)
